basic_info.description: Welcome to this wonderful 2 bed 1 bath located in the quiet Portola neighborhood of San Francisco. Recently updated kitchen and bathroom gives it a new age feel, while the layout, off kitchen deck and stretching back yard still hold on to San Francisco charm. The property offers ample parking with two garage spaces, and abundant on street parking thanks to the lack of neighbors across the road, a valuable amenity in San Francisco.The recently refinished original oak flooring throughout the home is designed for both style and durability. A short walking distance to a playground and trails, this home is a perfect starter home for a busy and health conscious family. Commuters dont fret- a short drives to BART, Caltrain, 101 and 280 we have. Come make this home yours!
